vuln_statements.explanation: This statement implements the work queue flush operation across multiple virtual interfaces. In the context of ath12k driver vulnerabilities, this loop combined with wiphy_work_flush() can introduce race conditions where work items may execute after their associated data structures (ar/vif) have been freed during driver removal or interface teardown. The incomplete snippet suggests this is part of a flush function that needs proper synchronization to prevent use-after-free scenarios when concurrent operations access the same data structures.
